title: TCCounts: specification uncertainty in western North Pacific and Philippine tropical cyclone count trends
description: Scripts and derived data behind an enumeration of the analytical choices that enter a fitted trend in tropical cyclone counts. Clips IBTrACS to the PAGASA Philippine Area of Responsibility hexagon, then fits a linear trend under every combination of six agency sets, four counting rules and fifty start years, for the western North Pacific basin and for the PAR, with a circular block bootstrap null for each of the 2,400 resulting specifications. Reproduces every value reported in the accompanying manuscript through 96 automated checks. Supersedes the v1 classified-versus-unclassified decomposition.
